title: Aurora Vanilla
description: Aurora Vanilla delivers smooth, stable performance with minimal visual changes, offering a clean, shader-ready vanilla experience.
body:
Aurora Vanilla is a carefully curated vanilla-style experience focused on smooth performance, stability, and subtle visual enhancement. It is designed for players who want Minecraft to run better and look cleaner without changing the core gameplay or art style.

This pack prioritizes high FPS and low latency while remaining fully shader-friendly, making it ideal for both low-end and high-end systems. Visual improvements are kept soft and natural, ensuring everything still feels unmistakably vanilla — just more refined.

Aurora Vanilla avoids unnecessary features and heavy modifications, focusing instead on optimization, compatibility, and consistency. Whether you’re building, exploring, or playing long survival sessions, the experience stays smooth, responsive, and reliable.
